visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 連假最有感. [Logo]: 搜尋/這群人. (2) [Variety]: 【連假排隊等車位】Parking on Holidays. (3) [Subtitle]: 不是吧. 剛剛塞這麼久現在在這邊又要排隊. (4) [Variety]: 插隊中. (5) [Subtitle]: 欸幹嘛啦. 很沒品欸. (6) [Variety]: 【連假去做美甲】Getting Manicure on Holidays. (7) [Subtitle]: 好了，謝謝。不客氣喔。不好意思喔兩位，請稍等喔. (8) [Variety]: 【連假移機車】Moving Scooters on Holidays. (9) [Subtitle]: 好了好了好了欸。後面要撞到了啦. (10) [Variety]: 【連假逛老街】Old Streets on Holidays. (11) [Subtitle]: 寶貝還是我們吃那個好不好。不要啦那個要排隊，那個排那麼長. (12) [Subtitle]: 啊不然要吃什麼嘛。吃便利商店就好了啦. (13) [Subtitle]: 好了好了好了。謝謝謝謝。走走走. (14) [Variety]: 【連假逛展覽】Going to Exhibition on Holidays. (15) [Subtitle]: 你好歡迎來到熊大航空. (16) [Variety]: 哇!. (17) [Subtitle]: 這邊還有我們的空姐跟我們莎莉導遊。哪裡?在哪裡?莎莉在哪裡?你說他太萌了啦。幫我拍照幫我拍照。額...額...。不好意思。拍照...。不好意思. (18) [Slogan]: 完整版這群人連假災難現場.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Audio begins with a vibrant, upbeat electronic synth BGM at a steady tempo. A male voice speaks with high pitch variability, expressing intense frustration. Occasional mechanical idling sounds are present in the low-frequency range. (2) A digital 'ding' sound effect marks a new phase. Two female voices interact with professional, calm prosody followed by a customer voice with higher vocal tension and strain. BGM persists throughout. (3) A sequence of metallic clinks and rapid footsteps triggers this phase. Multiple male voices are heard shouting instructions with high arousal. The rhythm of the speech is fast and fragmented. (4) Transition to a textured background of urban crowd chatter. A male and female voice engage in high-speed dialogue with a comedic, teasing tone and frequent rising intonations. (5) A sharp 'whoosh' transition leads to a loud crowd cheering sound effect. A female voice speaks with high intensity and volume, similar to a public announcement style. (6) Hyper-dense audio environment with overlapping voices, loud laughter samples, and simulated rapid-fire camera shutter sounds. The vocal density is at its maximum, conveying chaotic social energy.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Compilation of comedic holiday frustrations -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To humorously illustrate the common 'disasters' and inconveniences faced by people in Taiwan during long holidays—such as traffic, queues, and crowds—while promoting the full-length video content from 'This Group of People'.

high_inference.freeDescribe: This is a high-energy social media promo featuring rapid editing, iconic meme-style sound effects, and characteristic Taiwanese sketch comedy tropes.
